summary: ZenaTech filed a Form 6-K with a CEO letter to shareholders reporting a 558% YoY revenue increase to $12.9M, driven by a new Drone-as-a-Service segment generating $10.1M. The filing describes 20 completed acquisitions and asset growth but contains no special-situation event such as a transaction, strategic review, or activist campaign. It is a routine business update and shareholder letter. No deal terms are provided.
